name: Haddon Boys
description: The Haddon Boys were a Chicago street gang active from at least the mid-1960s through the early 1970s, operating in the Ukrainian Village and West Town neighborhoods on the city's West Side. They were rivals of the Chi-West gang, the Playboys, Spanish Lords, Latin Disciples, Dragons, and other local outfits that congregated around Chopin and Columbus schoolyards. The gang was notably larger than the Playboys, and on July 2, 1971, they fatally shot Playboys member Pete 'Kong' Smolak during an armed confrontation.
